Machine Learning Project

Customer Churn Prediction

Predicting which telecom customers are likely to leave, using Random Forest and XGBoost. Dataset: IBM Telco Customer Churn, 7,043 customers, 30 model features.

Find similar customers and check churn

Fill in whatever you know and leave the rest on Any. The page searches all 7,043 customers in the dataset, finds the ones who match, and shows how many of them actually churned. Tenure matches within 6 months and monthly charges within $10.

Test the model on the 20% test set

One click runs the model on the 1,409 customers it never saw in training and compares every prediction with what really happened. You can also upload a CSV with the same columns as telco_churn.csv.

How it works

1
Learn from history

80% of customers (5,634) with known outcomes teach the models.

2
Predict on unseen customers

The other 20% (1,409) are hidden from the model, which gives each a risk score from 0 to 1.

3
Check against reality

Predictions are compared with what really happened to measure accuracy.
